points.text: Only base vs base+SRGen; no random-delta, random-position, static-threshold or temperature controls attribute gain.
Gains insensitive to step size and loss terms, suggesting optimized objective does not drive gain.
No compute-matched Cons@k comparison despite ~50% extra time.
No variance, CIs or repeated runs; many gains within sampling noise.
Abstract headlines best cell rather than median gain.
Overhead cost model omits prefix-length term from full-prefix CE loss.
50% overhead measured only for one model, greedy, 4096 tokens; extrapolated to all.
Truncation, repetition and format-failure confounds not ruled out.
Hyperparameter selection protocol unstated; MATH500 subset overlaps reported result.
Minor: text-table mismatch in 5.2, inconsistent value granularity, figure legends.
Entropy spikes as error signal untested; triggers on function words, may suppress 'wait'.
Deployment cost under batched serving and memory not measured.
Evidence only on competition math; broader reasoning claims unsupported.
Sharpening may reduce diversity at large k; no diversity analysis.
Ethics statement safety recommendations lack detail.
Main table has no competitor; no decoding-level or compute-matched voting baseline.
Claims like 'consistently strengthen' overstated; many cells show no change.
Text/table slips, problem counts unstated, inconsistent code availability statement.
Typos, epochs/iterations terminology, Pass@k estimator unstated.
Insensitivity to step size and loss terms consistent with generic sharpening; reflection mechanism untested.
Headline gain is best cell; median much lower.
No repeated runs or CIs.
Bounded-overhead claim measured for one model/greedy/short budget.
Cost model omits prefix-length term.
No compute-matched, decoding-level or confidence-voting baseline.
Theorem 1 about exact minimizers, not few-step iterates; overclaims theoretical grounding.
'New paradigm' not differentiated from test-time entropy minimization (Tent, EM-INF).

Novelty claim not positioned against EM-INF and Tent entropy minimization.
'Reflection' is a metaphor; method only sharpens distributions.
Theorem 1 is standard weighted-sum fact, gives no lambda guidance, not about finite-step iterate.
Self-Refine, Reflexion, confidence-weighted voting baselines never compared; only SLOT.
Citation mismatch for Qwen2.5-Math; MATH500 uncited.
Self-referential delta optimization without ground truth may reinforce model biases.
Composability shown only with SLOT; other methods like contrastive decoding not tested.

Benchmarks limited to math.
Table 2 lacks percentage marks.
Latency reported only as ratios, not absolute time.
Notation t and k inconsistent; Avg@k defined before Pass@k.
Avg@k behaviour with increasing k not discussed.
Method expensive: ~50% inference time increase impractical.
No side-by-side comparison with other reasoning methods; only SLOT on one model.
Only math competition datasets; no coding or logic benchmarks.
No combination with RL-based post-training methods.
No empirical comparison to decoding methods (DoLA, SLED) or critical-token methods.
Many new hyperparameters conflict with plug-and-play claim.
Theory confusing; Theorem 1 generic Lagrangian equivalence not tied to specific losses.
Lambda has weak influence, questioning need for both loss terms; more datasets needed.
Entropy buffer prevents interventions on early tokens.
Experiments restricted to math datasets.
Unclear why CE loss spans all past tokens rather than a window.
Triggers dominated by function words; content-aware trigger ablation needed.
Self-consistency baselines limited; need temperature sweeps, ToT under equal budget.
Unclear whether comparisons use comparable inference budgets; more efficiency comparisons needed.
No thorough inference cost analysis across temperature, length, correction frequency.
No head-to-head comparisons with self-refinement/test-time baselines under matched compute.
Evaluation almost only math with math-tuned models.
One model degrades with SRGen, contradicting 'consistent gains'.
Entropy trigger blind to confident errors; failure mode unanalysed.
Orthogonality/compatibility overstated; only combined with SLOT.
Theorem 1 textbook Lagrangian fact; no guidance for choosing lambda.

Abstract headlines best cell rather than median.
Overhead measured only in one limited configuration.
Minor reporting, consistency and citation slips.
Entropy as error signal untested; function-word triggers.
Diversity reduction at large k unanalysed.
Theorem 1 standard and overclaimed as grounding.
Novelty not differentiated from test-time entropy minimization.

Avg@k trend with k not discussed.
Theorem 1 generic, not tied to losses, no guidance.

Function-word triggers; content-aware trigger ablation missing.
Limited sampling/search baselines under equal budget.
